metadata.description: Three stepped cyan chambers contain nested open boxes, narrow passages and offset crossbars. Cyan walls block movement and cannot close a cut. Six yellow bouncers roam the field and four cyan patrols start along the top border. Start at bottom center, move sideways around the central wall, and reconnect to the safe outer rail to reveal 75%.
